cc4479ce7bcb0da5e9bf2763fb4fd0ab6757f909: Feldberg is a low-key resort on a modest scale: 28 km of pistes for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Feldberg's reputation as a family resort is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the low mountain range for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Feldberg's modest altitude, from a base at 950 m to a summit at 1450 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you travel is strongly recommended. A stay in Feldberg is clearly on the expensive side: 59€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, Feldberg does not rival the giants of skiing and does not pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underestimated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
